task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a **Files** tab to the Conversation View strip — the same level as **Chat** and **Trajectory** — showing the session workspace as a tree with a basic text preview beside it.","id":"gh:1367175990","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-file-explorer","slug":"jaxzhou/dsh-file-explorer","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a **Files** t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ab to the Conversation View strip — the same level as **Chat** and **Trajectory** — showing the sess"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ion workspace as a tree with a basic text preview beside it."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-file-explorer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Published on npm as **`@jaxzhou/dsh-file-explorer`** — the unscoped name > `dsh-file-explorer` bel"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ongs to a different author's plugin."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A **Files** tab for DeepSeek Harness, beside **Chat** and **Trajectory**: the session workspace as a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" tree, and a preview that adapts to what the file is — rendered Markdown with its diagrams, a page o"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"f HTML, a JSON tree, highlighted source, an image, a PDF, or an unpacked Word, Excel or PowerPoint d"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ocument. Read-only, no configuration, nothing stored."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The left pane is the session's working directory, listed one level at a time, directories first. An "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"expanded level stays expanded while you move between preview tabs, and the pane itself folds away — "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"by its own control, or by opening a file. That last one is also how the pane behaves on a phone: bel"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ow 720 pixels the tree and the preview take turns instead of sharing a width neither of them fits in"},{"id":"p8s5","text":", and a finger gets bigger controls, a taller header, and a tab close button that is not waiting for"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" a hover it will never see."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Clicking a file opens it in a tab, so several files stay open at once — each with its own body and i"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ts own wrap setting. A file that is already open is focused rather than reopened, tabs whose names c"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ollide show their directory, and the tab's × or a middle click closes one. Right-click a tab for the"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" rest of the strip: **Close**, **Close others**, and **Close all**, opening where the pointer was."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The pane follows what it is showing. An open file is re-read when it changes, and an expanded direct"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ory is relisted when something in it is added, removed, or renamed — so an agent writing files while"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" you watch appears as it happens, with the tab you are reading updated in place rather than blanked "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ppears as it happens, with the tab you are reading updated in place rather than blanked and redrawn."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The right pane picks each tab's body from the file:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Category | Preview |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **Markdown** | Rendered GFM — headings, tables, task lists, quotes, math, footnotes, images refere"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nced beside the file, highlighted code fences, and **Mermaid diagrams** — with a **Source** toggle a"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"nd an **Export** menu | | **HTML** | Drawn as a page in a sandboxed frame: the file's own CSS applie"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"s, and its scripts run in an opaque origin that cannot reach this application. With a **Source** tog"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"gle and an **Export** menu | | **JSON** | A collapsible tree with per-value copy, and the same toggl"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"e | | **Source code** | Syntax highlighting, line numbers, and a copy button for 24 grammars: TypeSc"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ript/JavaScript, shell, Python, Ruby, Go, Rust, Java, C, C++, C#, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, YAML, TOML, IN"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"I, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Less, SQL, XML, Lua, MDX | [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Privacy"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Read-only.** Reads go through the harness's own `workspaceFiles` Remote namespace; the Host's fi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"lesystem decides what is readable. The plugin holds no file access, no path resolution, and no crede"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ntials of its own. - **Nothing stored.** No disk writes and nothing added to the session log; view s"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"tate lives in memory and is discarded with the session. - **Inert Host half.** The package's Node si"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"de registers no service, tool, prompt section, or event. - **Diagrams are drawn in the page.** Merma"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"id is bundled into the plugin and runs locally; drawing a diagram fetches nothing from anywhere. - *"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"*Office documents are unpacked in the page.** A `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` is read here, by this pl"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ugin's own reader; nothing about it leaves the browser. A PDF is handed to the browser's reader as a"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" local blob URL. - **HTML runs sandboxed.** A previewed page's scripts execute in an opaque origin, "},{"id":"p15s10","text":"which cannot read this application's DOM, storage, or session; an exported page is printed with its "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"scripts removed. An SVG draws through ``, so its scripts never run at all."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Preview only** — no editing, saving, or diffing. - **Strict JSON.** Comments or a trailing comma"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" make a file JSONC, which `JSON.parse` rejects — `tsconfig.json` is the common case. The pane says s"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"o and shows the highlighted source instead of guessing at a tree. - **Text previews stop at 2 000 li"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"nes**, with a truncation note and no "load more"; binary files report why they cannot be shown. - **"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"Fixed grammar set.** A suffix the shared highlighter does not carry is plain text, never an approxim"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ation. - **Listing only** — no search, rename, context menu, or file watching; a level refreshes thr"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ough **Reload**. - **Loaded previews are bounded.** A working set of five tabs keeps its content; an"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" older tab stays open and reads again when you return to it. - **One root.** The tree is rooted at t"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"he session's working directory, and the Host refuses directory listings outside the workspace root. "},{"id":"p17s10","text":"- **Markdown pulls in the images beside it.** A destination relative to the document is read through"},{"id":"p17s11","text":" the same workspace reader the file itself came from — up to 24 images per document and 8 MiB each. "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"A file mention in inline code, a remote URL, and an absolute path are left to the renderer's own rul"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"es: the first stays inert, the second loads directly, and the third is not fetched. - **HTML preview"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"s do not resolve relative assets.** A page drawn from a Blob document has no base to resolve its own"},{"id":"p17s15","text":" `style.css` or images against, so only absolute URLs load there. **An export does resolve them** — "},{"id":"p17s16","text":"the file it writes is read from a copy that has been made to stand alone — so a document can export "},{"id":"p17s17","text":"with pictures it does not show in the preview. - **An exported PDF's text is a picture.** Nothing in"},{"id":"p17s18","text":" it can be selected or searched — a *previewed* PDF is the browser's own reader, where it can. Expor"},{"id":"p17s19","text":"t Word instead when the text has to stay text. - **A Mermaid diagram is a picture too.** It is drawn"},{"id":"p17s20","text":" once, to a PNG, for the preview and for both exports — so its labels are not selectable, and it is "},{"id":"p17s21","text":"always drawn on white, because a PDF page and a Word document are white and a [该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
